query:
UPDATE invest_moves
           SET status = $2, amount = COALESCE($3, amount), check_url = COALESCE($4, check_url),
               note = COALESCE($5, note), decided_by = COALESCE($6, decided_by),
               finished_at = CASE WHEN $7 THEN now() ELSE finished_at END
         WHERE id = $1
